questions.stem_en: An AWS Config rule uses automatic remediation with a Systems Manager Automation document. The remediation occasionally fails because of short-lived errors, and the affected resources stay noncompliant until an engineer notices. The company wants failed remediations to be tried again automatically within a few minutes and wants to see the detailed status of each remediation run. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

choices_en.text: Set retries and a time period for the automatic remediation, such as 5 retries in 300 seconds, and check DescribeRemediationExecutionStatus for details.
Change the rule to manual remediation, and have an engineer start the remediation when a resource is noncompliant.
Write an AWS Lambda function that runs every minute, finds failed remediations, and starts the Automation document again.
Delete and re-create the AWS Config rule every hour so that all resources are evaluated and remediated again.

explanation.summary: 自動修復の後もリソースが準拠していない時は、やり直しの回数と秒数を入れて、ルールに自動修復をやり直させられます。やり直しは修復が失敗した時だけ、決めた期間の中で行われます（例: 300 秒で 5 回）。DescribeRemediationExecutionStatus は、修復の実行の状態や手順の時刻、失敗した手順のエラーを詳しく示します。

per_choice.A: 正しい。組み込みのやり直しで短い間のエラーをしのぎ、API で実行の状態を確かめられます。
per_choice.B: 手作業が増え、自動でやり直す要件に反します。
per_choice.C: 動きますが、組み込みの機能で済む仕組みを自分で作って保守することになります。
per_choice.D: 手間が大きく、作り直しの間は評価も修復も止まります。

references.quote: If a resource is still noncompliant after auto remediation, you can set the rule to try auto remediation again. Enter the desired retries and seconds.
Retries only occur if remediation fails and work within the specified time period; for example, 5 retries in 300 seconds.
DescribeRemediationExecutionStatus, provides a detailed view of a Remediation Execution for a set of resources

questions.stem_en: A security team needs a custom AWS Config rule that checks a company-specific setting whenever a resource's configuration changes, and wants noncompliant resources to be fixed automatically. The team does not want to develop or maintain Lambda functions in Java or Python. Which actions should a DevOps engineer take? (Choose TWO.)

choices_en.text: Create an AWS Config Custom Policy rule for the check.
Use PutRemediationConfigurations to associate an automatic remediation action that uses a Systems Manager Automation document with the rule.
Create an AWS Config Custom Lambda rule with a Python function that evaluates the configuration.
Associate the remediation action with a service-linked AWS Config rule that another AWS service created.
Choose manual remediation so that the security team starts each fix from the console.

explanation.summary: AWS Config の Custom Policy ルールは構成の変化で動き、Java や Python で Lambda 関数を作らずに独自のルールを作れます。PutRemediationConfigurations で、選んだアクションの修復の設定をルールに足せば、Systems Manager Automation のドキュメントで準拠していないリソースを直せます。

per_choice.A: 正しい。Lambda 関数を作らずに、構成の変化で動く独自のルールを作れます。
per_choice.B: 正しい。ルールに Automation のドキュメントを使う自動の修復を関連付けられます。
per_choice.C: 動きますが、Python の Lambda 関数を開発・保守することになり、要件に反します。
per_choice.D: 修復を管理できるのは、サービスにリンクされていない AWS Config ルールだけです。
per_choice.E: 手作業になり、自動で直す要件を満たしません。

references.quote: AWS Config Custom Policy rules are initiated by configuration changes.
AWS Config Custom Policy rules allow you to create AWS Config Custom rules without needing to use Java or Python to develop Lambda functions to manage your custom rules.
PutRemediationConfigurations, adds or updates the remediation configuration with a specific AWS Config rule with the selected target or action.
You can only manage remediations for non-service linked AWS Config rules.
